hints.title: Combined Difference Pool
hints.text: Modifying nums1 or nums2 amounts to subtracting from the absolute differences |nums1[i] - nums2[i]| using k = k1 + k2 operations.

hints.title: Convexity of Squares
hints.text: Because squares grow quadratically, decrementing larger differences produces greater reduction in total squared error.

hints.title: Frequency Bucket Leveling
hints.text: Count the frequency of each difference value up to max difference, then decrement values from highest to lowest.

hints.title: Frequency Buckets Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct bucket frequency counting eliminates heap overhead.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Extracting elements repeatedly from a priority queue takes O(k log n) time, which times out for k up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency count array of size M enables linear time reduction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that greedy decrementing of top elements can be batched using bucket counting or binary search.
